title: Process-local variable array write and read (mem(idx) := data)
sourceUrl: internal: pass 19 RAM_WRITE for process-local variables
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Case 131 counterpart using a process-local variable instead of an architecture-level signal. Exercises RAM_WRITE for `variable mem : mem_t; mem(to_integer(unsigned(addr))) := din;` inside a clocked process, followed by a signal-scheduled read `dout <= mem(to_integer(unsigned(addr)));` also inside the process. Fences pass 19's process-local RAM_WRITE lowering: local vars merged into synth scope, `:=` arrow recognised, IsVariable attr set on the RAM_WRITE cell.
